name: SquirrelTower
summary: SquirrelTower is a pixel-art arcade stacking game in which a squirrel builder constructs a tower by dropping floors from a crane. Players time each drop to align the floors, earn stars and combos, and improve their best height. The game features one-tap controls, changing weather and time-of-day scenes, and daily, weekly and all-time leaderboards through Google Play Games. Community events let players compete toward shared floor goals.
